preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_models WHERE provider = 'PERPLEXITY' AND model = 'openai/gpt-6-luna'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_models_capability amc JOIN ai_models m ON m.id = amc.model_id WHERE m.provider = 'PERPLEXITY' AND m.model = 'openai/gpt-6-luna'

changeSet.comment: Capabilities of Perplexity openai/gpt-6-luna. REASONING and TEMPERATURE stay off until verified against the API (a payload with both is rejected by the builder); FILE_UPLOAD is off because an attached document disables Perplexity's browsing tools.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO ai_models_capability (model_id, capability_id, enabled) SELECT m.id, c.id, CASE WHEN c.type IN ('WEB_SEARCH', 'SYSTEM_PROMPT', 'RESPONSE_SCHEMA') THEN true ELSE false END FROM ai_models m, ai_capability c WHERE m.provider = 'PERPLEXITY' AND m.model = 'openai/gpt-6-luna';
